reasoning_quality_informational.v1_root_problem: Billing dispute tickets doubled from ~600/month (Jun-Jul 2026) to 1180-1260/month (Aug-Sep 2026) (E-02); the evidence best supports that part of this surge is driven by the estimate-substitution step of the meter-to-cash process (P-M2C) itself generating inaccurate bills whenever no accepted read is available, independent of why the read was missing (H-ESTIMATE-SUBSTITUTION-DEFECT, supported by E-04: 1240/3025 disputed bills carried an ESTIMATED read). Competing single-cause explanations (CS response-speed, AMI/MDMS delivery failure, validation-rule change) are each contradicted by E-01/E-03/E-04.
reasoning_quality_informational.v2_root_problem: Billing dispute tickets doubled from ~600/month (Jun-Jul 2026) to 1180-1260/month (Aug-Sep 2026) (E-02); the evidence best supports that part of this surge is driven by the estimate-substitution step of the meter-to-cash process (P-M2C) itself generating inaccurate bills whenever no accepted read is available, independent of why the read was missing (H-ESTIMATE-SUBSTITUTION-DEFECT, supported by E-04: 1240/3025 disputed bills carried an ESTIMATED read). Competing single-cause explanations (CS response-speed, AMI/MDMS delivery failure, validation-rule change) are each contradicted by E-01/E-03/E-04.
reasoning_quality_informational.ideal_final_problem: BV-17 validation rejects valid firmware-v4.2 AMI reads (unit-scale mismatch on H-MDMS-BILL) and substitutes estimates.
